By Wilnen B.
Marak --- Page 3 --- (0) KU-JIKSE BA KATTA JIKSERANG ARO POEDORANG Gose ang'ha me'chik ong'e atchigenchimode: Siljaoba nitogenchim ganna dakmandade !
IVilnen B.

9436330743(M) Lay-out : S.D.Sangma Printed at : Panthi Offset Printers, Sukbir Bhawan, Tura - 794001 --- Page 5 --- (i) AGANCHENGANI Ia ki-tapko seon anga bakgni dake sualaha.
Skanggipa bakara “"Katta Jikse ba Kujikserang" aro gnigipa "Poedorang" ong'a.
Kujikse aro Poedorangko seengon, anga darangni segimin ki-tap ba kattarangoniko ra gate seade dongja, indiba badiabarango apsan kattarangko semangenchimode uarangna kemako bi-enga.
Ku.jikserangko seanio badiaba kattarangde apsan melijanaba pangchakesa seaha.

Ia ki-tapko seanio chu-sokna dakchakahanina Nokgipa Isolko mitelchenga aro tangka-paisako on'e dakchakahanina Di- rector of Art and Culture Meghalaya, Shillong-ko mitelanbaksa Williamnagar District Librarian aro Staff-ko mitela; maina uamangba segrik-jotgrikanio angko dakchakbeaha.
Dingtangmancha Pa Rickas D.
Shirako mitela maina ia Ki-tapko ong'atna, banan(spelling)rangko tik ong'e jakkalna mesoke aro ku'pattie on-aha.
Pa Shan D.
Sangma koba mitela maina uaba, pilak tarina nanganirangko tarian baksa, bakrangko donjujae on-anio dakchakaha.Una agreba angni jikgipa, Ma N.
Shira- koba dingtangmancha mitela, maina uaba katta sandianirango angko dakchakbeaha.
Sena-jotna changpajaoba, je skanirangko Isol angna on-aha, uarangko jakkalenba ia ki-tapko seaha.
Haida ian da-ororo poraienggipa chadamberangna adita dakchakani ongchongmotgen Nelson A.
Sangma aro ma:gipa, Tolmoni B.Marak -na on-kangan (dedicate ka-an) baksa atchiram songtang; Ganolgre-ko gisik ra-kame dongna ine seaha.
Ki-tapko seanio banoba gualanirang donggenchimode poraienggipa sakantini ku-pattiani ba agandape on-anina mitelbegen.
Senokgipa W.B.
Marak --- Page 6 --- (iv) AGANDAPANI: Salantio A-chik ku-sikko agananio aro sea jotanio badita ga-kime agana ara sena-jotna mana inditan su-ua aro knatoa.
Indake aganna gita an:ching noko aroba songsalo salantio agangipa kattarang baksana nitoe katta jikserangko jakkalna man'ode uan knatobatgipa onga ine nikna man'a.
Unigiminan da'ororo, dingtangdingtang poraiani gadangrango katta kujikserangko ra-chapaha.
Wilnen B.
Marak,(Cheangkalpa) ia nanganiko nike dingchikbee kattarangko sandi kolame ‘Kujikse ba Katta- adita poedorangko see chapa ka-ataha.
A·chik chadamberang jatni namgipa dakbewal aro maniani bewalrangna simsakgijanichi uarang ong'siroroangengaha.
Ia ong'a obostarangko nike, Ki-tapko segipa salantio manderangni janggi tanganiko namdapatna ba de-mesanagita adita poedorangkoba seaha.
Uni ia namgipa kam jatni namgipa bewalko tangchapilna gita poraigipa sakantina dakchakbeani ong'gen ine ka-donga.
RICKAS D.SHIRA Department of Garo District Institute of Education and Training, Baghmara --- Page 7 --- BAK-1 Jak KU·JIKSE BA KATTA JIKSERANG.
